note: Short summaries written for DS Cortex (not abstracts). Context, not a literature review: verify before citing.

notes.title: Random Forests
notes.summary: Averages many decorrelated trees grown on bootstrap samples with random feature subsets; a strong, low-tuning default for tabular classification and regression.
notes.tags: tabular classification regression ensemble trees default robust

notes.title: Greedy Function Approximation: A Gradient Boosting Machine
notes.summary: Builds an additive model stage by stage, each tree fitted to the gradient of the loss; the basis of modern boosted trees.

notes.title: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
notes.summary: Regularized, sparsity-aware gradient boosting with efficient split finding; widely used on structured data.

notes.title: LightGBM: A Highly Efficient Gradient Boosting Decision Tree
notes.summary: Leaf-wise histogram boosting with sampling tricks for speed on large tabular data.
notes.tags: tabular boosting lightgbm large data speed

notes.title: Why do tree-based models still outperform deep learning on typical tabular data?
notes.summary: Benchmark showing tree ensembles remain the strongest choice on medium-sized tabular datasets, partly because of uninformative features and irregular target functions.
notes.tags: tabular trees deep learning benchmark medium data

notes.title: Tabular Data: Deep Learning is Not All You Need
notes.summary: Compares deep tabular models with XGBoost and finds boosting usually equal or better with less tuning.

notes.title: Ridge Regression: Biased Estimation for Nonorthogonal Problems
notes.summary: Adds an L2 penalty that trades a little bias for much lower variance when predictors are highly correlated.
notes.tags: multicollinearity regularization ridge linear high vif

notes.title: Regression Shrinkage and Selection via the Lasso
notes.summary: An L1 penalty shrinks coefficients and sets some exactly to zero, giving sparse, interpretable linear models.
notes.tags: lasso feature selection sparse linear regularization

notes.title: Regularization and Variable Selection via the Elastic Net
notes.summary: Mixes L1 and L2 penalties so groups of correlated predictors are kept or dropped together.
notes.tags: elastic net correlated features regularization linear

notes.title: Estimating the Support of a High-Dimensional Distribution
notes.summary: Introduces the one-class SVM, which learns a boundary around normal data for novelty detection.

notes.title: Isolation Forest
notes.summary: Anomalies are isolated in fewer random splits; scales linearly and needs no distance metric.

notes.title: LOF: Identifying Density-Based Local Outliers
notes.summary: Scores each point by how isolated it is relative to the density of its neighbours.

notes.title: A Density-Based Algorithm for Discovering Clusters in Large Spatial Databases with Noise
notes.summary: DBSCAN groups dense regions, finds arbitrary shapes and labels sparse points as noise.

notes.title: k-means++: The Advantages of Careful Seeding
notes.summary: Spreads initial centroids out, giving faster convergence and better k-means solutions in expectation.

notes.title: Silhouettes: A Graphical Aid to the Interpretation and Validation of Cluster Analysis
notes.summary: Defines the silhouette width comparing within-cluster cohesion with separation from the nearest other cluster.

notes.title: A Cluster Separation Measure
notes.summary: Ratio of within-cluster scatter to between-cluster separation; lower values mean better separated clusters.

notes.title: Estimating the Dimension of a Model
notes.summary: The Bayesian information criterion penalizes model size; used to choose the number of mixture components.

notes.title: Time Series Analysis: Forecasting and Control
notes.summary: Systematic identification, estimation and checking of ARIMA models, including seasonal variants.

notes.title: Another Look at Measures of Forecast Accuracy
notes.summary: Reviews forecast error measures and recommends scale-free errors judged against naive benchmarks.
notes.tags: time series forecast accuracy smape naive benchmark

notes.title: The M4 Competition: Results, Findings, Conclusion and Way Forward
notes.summary: Large forecasting competition where combinations and well-tuned statistical methods were hard to beat and simple benchmarks stayed competitive.

notes.title: A Note on the Validity of Cross-Validation for Evaluating Autoregressive Time Series Prediction
notes.summary: Shows when standard cross-validation is valid for autoregressive models and why ordered evaluation is the safe default.
notes.tags: time series cross validation evaluation ordered split

notes.title: A Study of Cross-Validation and Bootstrap for Accuracy Estimation and Model Selection
notes.summary: Recommends stratified ten-fold cross-validation for model selection on real-world data.
notes.tags: cross validation model selection stratified evaluation

notes.title: Bias in Error Estimation When Using Cross-Validation for Model Selection
notes.summary: Reusing the same folds to tune and to report performance is optimistically biased; nested CV or a held-out set fixes it.
notes.tags: cross validation bias tuning nested holdout

notes.title: On Over-fitting in Model Selection and Subsequent Selection Bias in Performance Evaluation
notes.summary: Model selection itself can overfit; performance estimates must come from data not used for selection.
notes.tags: overfitting model selection bias evaluation holdout

notes.title: Leakage in Data Mining: Formulation, Detection, and Avoidance
notes.summary: Defines leakage as information unavailable at prediction time and shows how it inflates results.

notes.title: Leakage and the Reproducibility Crisis in Machine-Learning-Based Science
notes.summary: Surveys leakage across scientific fields and proposes model info sheets to document train-test separation.

notes.title: SMOTE: Synthetic Minority Over-sampling Technique
notes.summary: Creates synthetic minority examples by interpolating neighbours to counter class imbalance.

notes.title: Learning from Imbalanced Data
notes.summary: Survey of sampling, cost-sensitive and algorithmic remedies for imbalanced classification and how to evaluate them.
notes.tags: imbalanced classification cost sensitive class weights evaluation

notes.title: The Precision-Recall Plot Is More Informative than the ROC Plot When Evaluating Binary Classifiers on Imbalanced Datasets
notes.summary: On imbalanced data, precision-recall curves reveal weaknesses that ROC curves hide.
notes.tags: imbalanced precision recall roc evaluation pr auc

notes.title: The Relationship Between Precision-Recall and ROC Curves
notes.summary: Proves a curve dominates in ROC space if and only if it dominates in PR space, and discusses PR interpolation.

notes.title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
notes.summary: Modern networks are often overconfident; temperature scaling is a simple, effective post-hoc fix; introduces ECE reporting.
notes.tags: calibration expected calibration error temperature scaling confidence

notes.title: Predicting Good Probabilities with Supervised Learning
notes.summary: Boosted trees and SVMs produce distorted probabilities; Platt scaling and isotonic regression correct them.

notes.title: A Unified Approach to Interpreting Model Predictions
notes.summary: SHAP attributes a prediction to features using Shapley values with consistency guarantees.

notes.title: From Local Explanations to Global Understanding with Explainable AI for Trees
notes.summary: Exact, fast SHAP values for tree ensembles and global summaries built from local explanations.

notes.title: Stop Explaining Black Box Machine Learning Models for High Stakes Decisions and Use Interpretable Models Instead
notes.summary: Argues that for high-stakes decisions inherently interpretable models should be preferred over post-hoc explanations.

notes.title: Statistical Modeling: The Two Cultures
notes.summary: Contrasts data-modelling and algorithmic-modelling cultures and argues for predictive accuracy as a criterion.

notes.title: Statistical Comparisons of Classifiers over Multiple Data Sets
notes.summary: Recommends non-parametric tests such as the Wilcoxon signed-rank test when comparing methods across datasets.
notes.tags: evaluation statistics wilcoxon multiple datasets comparison

notes.title: Inference and Missing Data
notes.summary: Defines missing completely at random, missing at random and not at random, and when missingness can be ignored.
notes.tags: missing data mcar mar mnar mechanism

notes.title: A Test of Missing Completely at Random for Multivariate Data with Missing Values
notes.summary: A chi-square test of whether data are MCAR using means across missingness patterns.

notes.title: mice: Multivariate Imputation by Chained Equations in R
notes.summary: Iterative imputation that models each incomplete variable from the others, producing multiple imputations.
notes.tags: missing data imputation mice chained equations

notes.title: Confident Learning: Estimating Uncertainty in Dataset Labels
notes.summary: Uses out-of-sample predicted probabilities and per-class thresholds to find likely label errors.
notes.tags: label noise confident learning label errors

notes.title: Classification in the Presence of Label Noise: A Survey
notes.summary: Surveys the effects of label noise and robust, cleansing and noise-modelling approaches.

notes.title: Doubly Robust Policy Evaluation and Learning
notes.summary: Combines a reward model with inverse propensity weighting so the estimate is accurate if either part is.
notes.tags: offline policy evaluation doubly robust bandit ipw

notes.title: A Generalization of Sampling Without Replacement from a Finite Universe
notes.summary: Inverse-probability weighting gives unbiased estimates under unequal selection probabilities; the root of IPW.

notes.title: A Contextual-Bandit Approach to Personalized News Article Recommendation
notes.summary: LinUCB for contextual bandits, with an unbiased offline replay evaluation on logged data.

notes.title: Failing Loudly: An Empirical Study of Methods for Detecting Dataset Shift
notes.summary: Univariate two-sample tests on features, aggregated with a correction, are strong and simple shift detectors.
notes.tags: dataset shift drift two sample test ks

notes.title: Efficient and Robust Automated Machine Learning
notes.summary: auto-sklearn warm-starts its search from configurations that worked on datasets with similar meta-features.
notes.tags: automl meta learning warm start meta features similar datasets

notes.title: DS-Agent: Automated Data Science by Empowering Large Language Models with Case-Based Reasoning
notes.summary: An LLM agent retrieves and adapts past solutions to similar tasks to build data-science pipelines.
notes.tags: llm agent case based reasoning data science memory

notes.title: Improving Factuality and Reasoning in Language Models through Multiagent Debate
notes.summary: Several model instances propose and critique answers over rounds, improving factuality on several benchmarks.

notes.title: A Preprocessing Scheme for High-Cardinality Categorical Attributes in Classification and Prediction Problems
notes.summary: Replaces each category with a smoothed estimate of the target, a compact encoding for many levels.

notes.title: A New Family of Power Transformations to Improve Normality or Symmetry
notes.summary: A power transform that, unlike Box-Cox, works for zero and negative values.
notes.tags: power transform skew normality yeo johnson

notes.title: A Simple Test for Heteroscedasticity and Random Coefficient Variation
notes.summary: Regresses squared residuals on the predictors to test for non-constant error variance.

notes.title: Testing for Serial Correlation in Least Squares Regression
notes.summary: A statistic near 2 indicates no first-order autocorrelation in regression residuals.

notes.title: Random Search for Hyper-Parameter Optimization
notes.summary: Random search beats grid search when only a few hyperparameters matter.

notes.title: Optuna: A Next-generation Hyperparameter Optimization Framework
notes.summary: Define-by-run search spaces with efficient sampling and pruning.

notes.title: Statistical Power Analysis for the Behavioral Sciences
notes.summary: Introduces effect-size conventions (small, medium, large) for reporting practical significance.
notes.tags: effect size cohen d practical significance

notes.title: The ASA Statement on p-Values: Context, Process, and Purpose
notes.summary: p-values do not measure effect size or importance and should not be reported alone.
notes.tags: p values effect size statistics reporting
